tasks.short: Participate in recruitment, registration and placement

Assess the teacher's required academic contribution to registration and placement suitability, discuss unresolved readiness or practical-placement needs and distinguish a recommendation from an admission decision reserved to another authority.

Participate in actual placement activities with the student and responsible placement staff, discussing suitable recreation or fitness settings, learning requirements and unresolved practical constraints.

tasks.short: Select and obtain textbooks and teaching supplies

steps.what: Establish actual course outcomes, learner accessibility, quantities, facility constraints, current stock and permitted budget for the recreation or fitness teaching materials.

Find current textbook editions and supplies in approved catalogues {PROCUREMENT}, checking identifiers, accessibility, availability, price and delivery; native saved catalogue views reduce repeated navigation.

Select materials and supplies, such as textbooks, by examining actual content and suitability for recreation, leisure, exercise physiology or facilities teaching, balancing quality, accessibility and cost.

Prepare the actual authorised order in {PROCUREMENT}; native catalogue fields reuse selected item identifiers, edition, price and supplier while retaining quantity, cost-centre and delivery-entry checks.
inputs: actual order authority and delivery details

steps.what: Check the completed order's exact items, edition, quantities, total cost, budget authority, supplier and delivery destination against the selected materials and actual permissions.
inputs: actual order authority and delivery details

steps.what: Commit the exact checked order to the internal {PROCUREMENT} record.
Send the exact checked authorised order to the selected supplier through {PROCUREMENT} to obtain the materials and supplies.
Receive and physically check the actual delivered teaching materials against the ordered edition, quantities and condition, resolving discrepancies with the responsible purchasing contact.
Enter the actual receipt findings in {PROCUREMENT} and check the completed received quantities, edition and discrepancies against the physical receipt.
Save the exact checked receipt record in {PROCUREMENT}.

Course owners supply outcomes and quantities; the teacher checks stock in s1. Suppliers supply item/edition identifiers, prices, availability and delivery terms, verified in s2. Missing fields require manual supplier clarification within retained lookup time.

The ordinary final-order check in s5 gates separate save and send actions. The completed actual receipt check in s9 gates s10. Any changed content, supplier, cost or delivery/receipt facts invalidates its gate without added self-approval labour.
Shares and reductions are E1 scenario estimates, not measured baselines. Native functions are tested first; save runtime is fully retained and no payment automation is claimed.
